# WA Lookup WhatsApp Number Checker API
> Official synchronous examples for single and batch WhatsApp registration checks by WA Lookup.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://walookup.com/products/ws): Official WhatsApp Registration Check product overview.
- [API documentation](https://walookup.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/walookup/whatsapp-number-checker-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://walookup.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://walookup.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: WA Lookup.
- Product code: `ws`.
- API base URL: https://walookup.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Input: E.164 phone number.
- Processing: synchronous single or batch response.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, JavaScript, Shell.

## Integration contract
- Single: JSON `POST /api/v1/check` with `service_type=ws` and one `identifier`.
- Batch: JSON `POST /api/v1/batch-check` with `service_type=ws` and 1–100 `identifiers`.
- Batch results preserve input order.
- `exists=false` means undetermined; `registered` is present only when `exists=true`.
- Limits: 200 submitted numbers per UTC minute, 5 concurrent checks, and one concurrent batch.
- `GET /api/v1/balance` returns `data.balance_micros`.

## Security and usage
- Read the API key from the `WALOOKUP_API_KEY` environment variable.
- Never expose an API key in production browser code.
- Process only phone numbers you are authorized to verify.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-18.
